info.name: qauthgoogle - Sign in with Google (OAuth 2.0)
info.description:
Collection for the ASP.NET Core 'Sign in with Google' OAuth 2.0 demo.

NOTE: The login itself is an interactive, browser-based redirect flow and cannot be fully scripted in a single Postman request. Sign in via the browser first, then paste the '.AspNetCore.Cookies' value into the collection variable 'cookie' to call protected endpoints such as /account/me.

variable.description: Value of the .AspNetCore.Cookies cookie copied from the browser after signing in.

request.description: Starts the OAuth 2.0 flow. This returns a 302 redirect to Google's consent screen and must be completed in a real browser.
Returns the signed-in user's profile as JSON. Requires a valid auth cookie in the 'cookie' variable.
Clears the authentication cookie and redirects to '/'.
